lines: 东域青州，玄天宗密室。
无尽幽暗之中，古老神殿悬立。
绝美无双的银发女子站于神殿入口，她以银月为冠，星辰为衣，裙尾拖拽之处有着各色霞光浮现。
“吞天神脉早已铸成，如今已经过去九天了，你考虑得如何？”
银发女子对秦云问道。
秦云深吸了一口气，说道：“前辈，我已经考虑清楚了，我不想吸收吞天神脉。”
自从三年前获得这座太古封神殿后，秦云的日子就非常不好过，每隔三天就要被太古封神殿吸收力量。
吸收就吸收吧。
每一次吸收都会让秦云痛不欲生。
前段时间太古封神殿不再吸收力量，秦云以为自己可以解脱了。
结果又被银发女子拽入太古封神殿内，并要求他吸收吞天神脉。
秦云肯定不干了。
太古封神殿吸收了他三年的力量。
他也痛苦了三年。
现在吸收这吞天神脉，肯定没好事。
秦云是真的怕了，他不想再承受非人的折磨和痛苦了。
银发女子凝视着秦云问道：“你可知道，吞天神脉如果出世的话，会引起多少人争夺？”
“别说人了，就算是神也要争得你死我活。”
“现在拥有它的机会已经摆在你面前了，你难道打算就这么放弃？”
“这三年来，你承受了多少次非人的痛苦，好不容易凝出的吞天神脉，你就不要了？”
银发女子白皙的手轻轻一挥。
通体金黄的吞天神脉展现在秦云面前，它的脉络分布和人体经脉一模一样，不同的是它周身布满了古老的神纹。
这些神纹，每一道都散发着玄妙而强大的气息。
吞天神脉一看就不凡。
秦云还是咬了咬牙，别过头，“不要了！”
银发女子漠然地看着秦云说道：“我等待万年，才等到一个合适之人，你如果放弃，我还要再等万年。”
“这样吧，我在此地等你三天。”
“三天之后，如果你不来，吞天神脉就会崩碎，太古封神殿将会重新坠入虚空之中。”
秦云转身离开了密室。
走出密室后，秦云准备去洗漱一遍。
咚咚……
震耳欲聋的鼓声传遍了整个玄天宗。
“玄天鼓八响……宗内出大事了？”
秦云皱了皱眉。
“少主！”
content_en:
Qingzhou in the Eastern Region, Xuantian Sect's secret room.
In the endless darkness, the ancient temple hangs.
The extremely beautiful silver-haired woman stood at the entrance of the temple. She wore the silver moon as her crown, stars as her clothes, and various colors of rays of light emerged where the skirt trailed.
"The Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein has been forged a long time ago. It's been nine days now. What do you think about it?"
The silver-haired woman asked Qin Yun.
Qin Yun took a deep breath and said: "Senior, I have thought about it clearly. I don't want to absorb the Tiantian Divine Vein."
Ever since he obtained the Ancient Sealed Temple three years ago, Qin Yun's life has been very difficult. He has to be absorbed by the Ancient Sealed Temple every three days.
Just absorb it.
Every time it is absorbed, Qin Yun will be in agony.
Some time ago, the Ancient Sealed Temple stopped absorbing power, and Qin Yun thought he could be freed.
As a result, he was dragged into the Ancient Sealed Temple by a silver-haired woman and asked him to absorb the Heaven-Devouring Divine Vein.
Qin Yun will definitely quit.
The Ancient Sealed Temple absorbed his power for three years.
He also suffered for three years.
Absorbing this Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein now will definitely not do anything good.
Qin Yun was really scared. He didn't want to endure inhuman torture and pain anymore.
The silver-haired woman stared at Qin Yun and asked: "Do you know how many people will fight for the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein if it is born?"
"Forget about humans, even gods will fight to the death."
"Now that the opportunity to own it has been placed in front of you, are you going to just give up?"
"In the past three years, how many times have you endured inhuman pain, and you don't want to give up the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Veins that you finally developed?"
The silver-haired woman waved her white hand gently.
The golden Devouring Heaven Divine Vein appeared in front of Qin Yun. Its vein distribution was exactly the same as the human body's meridians. The difference was that its whole body was covered with ancient divine patterns.
Each of these divine patterns exudes a mysterious and powerful aura.
The Devouring Heaven Divine Vein is extraordinary at first glance.
Qin Yun still gritted his teeth and turned his head away, "No more!"
The silver-haired woman looked at Qin Yun indifferently and said, "I have been waiting for ten thousand years to find the right person. If you give up, I will have to wait for another ten thousand years."
"Well, I'll wait for you here for three days."
"In three days, if you don't come, the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Vein will collapse, and the Ancient Sealed Temple will fall into the void again."
Qin Yun turned around and left the secret room.
After walking out of the secret room, Qin Yun was going to wash up.
Dong Dong...
The deafening drum sound spread throughout the Xuantian Sect.
"The Xuantian drum rings eight times... Something big happened in the sect?"
Qin Yun frowned.
"Young Master!"
